title: The Slow Terminal
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Rafael Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
